summary: Tween engine with no setup: start a tween from anywhere and get a handle back.
overview: Call Tween.Float, Tween.Vector3 or Tween.Color and the tween starts immediately — no GameObject to add, no component to configure — returning a TweenHandle you can pause or kill. TweenExtensions adds the DOTween-style shortcuts on top, and one central runner ticks everything rather than each tween owning an Update.
useCases: Animating UI without a dependency on a tweening asset.
Short one-off moves, fades and colour changes from gameplay code.
Anything needing to be cancelled mid-flight, via the handle.

gotchas.title: Keep the handle if the target can die
gotchas.body: A tween holding a destroyed transform is the classic source of a null reference mid-animation. Kill it when the object goes away — or return it to a pool, which disables it and has the same effect.

gotchas.title: Zero setup means nothing stops you double-tweening
gotchas.body: Two tweens on the same property both run and fight. Kill the previous handle before starting a replacement.
